author: Unity
description:
Unity Industry Cloud is a collaborative 3D platform designed for teams to create, review, and deliver immersive experiences. This video focuses on Unity Asset Manager, showing you how to upload, organize, and prepare your CAD files for production use. 

The Asset Manager is a centralized system for managing CAD and 3D assets across teams. It supports structured metadata, version history, asset control, and file streaming, ensuring consistent asset state, and traceability throughout review, optimization, and downstream workflows.

Topics covered in this video:
✅ Asset Manager setup and project creation
✅ Asset organization and metadata
✅ Inspection and optimization
✅ Finalization

Unity Asset Manager is available with both the Unity Industry and Unity Studio subscriptions. Unity Studio is a no-code, web-based editor that empowers anyone within an organization to create and share in 3D.
